3716.title: Concurrent dispatch loses competing sends
3716.rootCauseOneLine: Concurrent idle sends pass admission before the first commits; later start transactions roll back without retaining inline inputs.
3716.proposedFix: Recheck status inside append preflight and reattempt dispatch on mismatch.
3716.caveats: Service-level reproduction; live-provider timing and general caller retry safety were not tested.
